_comment: THE DEVICE-UNDER-TEST BINDING. All four experiments instantiate the
subcircuits this file names; none of them contains a comparator netlist.
Swapping the placeholder for the ratified design is a one-line edit here.
netlist     path relative to sim/, must satisfy the interface contract
in sim/dut/README.md (checked at load time by harness/dut.py)
id          short identifier stamped into every record and deck header
every record it produces carry a banner saying the numbers
substantiate the harness and not a spec row
params      operating-point parameters the harness emits as .param, so
all four benches bias the DUT identically without each
description: The ratified topology from spec/decision-records/0001-comparator-topology.md: a single-tail (bottom-tail) StrongARM dynamic latch on sg13_lv_nmos/sg13_lv_pmos, with isolation inverters and a NOR SR output latch holding dout/doutb between strobes. Regenerated from design/comparator*.sch by design/netlist.py -- see design/README.md. Per that DR's Decision Section 3, this topology has no DC-resolvable analog front end, so comparator_dut_analog here is the DR's own named interim path: a diode-connected, loop-broken reduced sub-model, NOT the design's actual front end -- an offset/noise LOWER BOUND that excludes regeneration noise. Read design/README.md before quoting any number measured against it.
notes: dut_ib is the tail-mirror reference current forced into the `ibias` pin.
dut_vcm is the input common mode the front end is specified at. It is a property of the DUT, not of any one testbench, so it lives here.

0.6 V is mid-rail (VDD/2 at the nominal 1.2 V SG13G2 LV supply) -- there is no CDAC or other driving circuit to inherit a common mode from here, so mid-rail is the natural standalone choice, matching gf180-comparator's identical convention at its own nominal rail.

dut_ib = 20uA matches spec/decision-records/0001-comparator-topology.md's own 'Sizing rationale' section, which names this value as the harness's existing expectation absent a documented reason to change it -- carried over unchanged from the placeholder binding.

provenance: schematic means these records substantiate DR-0001's chosen topology's own measured behaviour -- NOT that README.md's target-specification table rows are met. That ratification is a separate, later act (spec/porting-plan.md's third step in this chain); see sim/dut/README.md.
